scope: Full multi-turn task evaluation scaffold for E1; historical experiments/runner.py E1/E2 parse-only and C1 30/20 are development material, not a formal blind test.

gold_contract.expected_tools: A nonempty JSON array of acceptable tool-name sequences; each sequence is an ordered array and may be empty to adjudicate that no tool call is appropriate. Tool names must exist in agents.tools.TOOL_NAMES. Null is allowed only in unadjudicated drafts.
gold_contract.poi_comparison: Stable POI IDs; ordered via and candidate lists are compared exactly. Null means no entity expected.
gold_contract.adjudication: Formal test gold requires an independent human reviewer, manual_independent method, and cited evidence. Adjudicated turns also require a controlled intent_label and one or more acceptable expected_tools sequences. Draft cases cannot be formal runs.

observation_contract.format: JSONL, one object per scenario_id and one-based attempt; input_messages must exactly echo the preregistered user messages and snapshot_id must match the gold case
observation_contract.turns: Each observation has turns in the same order as gold messages. Each turn projects status, kind, stable POI IDs, ordered vias/candidates, travel mode, strategy, hard constraints, outputs, clarification slot, explicit unknowns, and actual route_edge_ids if any. When opt-in LLM planner tracing is enabled, tool_trace records only tool_name, argument_keys, outcome, and artifact_kind; raw argument values and tool results are never saved. Optional top-level latency_s, tool_calls, input_tokens, output_tokens provide cost metrics; tool_calls must equal the sum of complete projected tool_trace records when every turn has a trace. Unprojected fields are rejected before saving.
observation_contract.independent_review: For spatial output supply source=independent_reviewer, reviewer, evidence references, route=pass|fail|unknown, hard_constraints verdicts, and non-route output verdicts. Product verifier/self-reported completion is not ground truth.
observation_contract.tool_trace_semantics: Tool-use scoring compares the ordered tool names against human-adjudicated expected_tools. A missing trace means unknown, not an empty sequence. Raw tool arguments and results are never stored. Tool-use findings are a separate diagnostic and do not change task_success.
observation_contract.route_edge_id: Stable (u,v,key) reference from the frozen graph; a separate reviewer must inspect connectivity, event snapshot, mode, budget, ordered vias, and applicable hard constraints.

scoring.complete_task_success_denominator: All planned scenario attempts; missing observations fail. Scenario mean averages each scenario's attempt success fraction, so repeats are not independent cases.
scoring.hard_constraint_violation_denominator: Spatial outputs with a documented independent route verdict and all applicable hard-constraint verdicts decisive; report spatial output coverage, unknowns and refusal counts separately.
scoring.unknown_policy: Unknown independent evidence never counts as complete task success. Allowed task-data unknowns must be preregistered in gold; unlisted unknowns fail. Tool selection is reported separately: exact accepted call-sequence match is pass, mismatch is fail, missing opt-in trace is unknown, and missing human gold is unadjudicated. Tool selection does not alter complete task success.
scoring.tool_selection_metric: Report pass/fail accuracy over decisive adjudicated turns only, plus unknown and unadjudicated counts; do not treat absent trace as zero calls or product failure.

formal_requires: leakage-free audit against a separate development split
Agent gate ready frozen snapshot manifest with every required input digest
run_rules.freeze_policy: If a test error is inspected and used to repair code or data, mark that batch seen and reserve new unseen cases for an independent test.
